column3: C reads uninit stack residue for len>4 (verifier stress test); Rust zero-inits stack_buf — deterministic refinement, test contract only exercises len=4
LLVM folds C source !(data+thoff) null-check to !data (ptr-provenance); Rust checks data+thoff faithfully — diverges only for skb->data==0 && thoff!=0, a NULL packet pointer the kernel never produces
C deliberately returns uninit stack residue array[9] (verifier-coverage test); Rust zero-inits the array — deterministic refinement, same class as test_stack_var_off

Rust masks skb->protocol to 16 bits before compare; C switch() compares the full 32-bit ctx word — diverges only when the upper 16 bits of the kernel-zero-extended protocol field are nonzero, impossible from the kernel

deliberate translation divergence (documented in lru_bug.rs): C writes a zeroed map value and relies on kernel LRU node reuse to leave stale ptr bytes; Rust reconstructs the same post-state by probe-reading the recorded address and writing those bytes — the map_update trace argument bytes differ by design

deliberate translation divergence (documented in test_core_reloc_type_based.rs): rustc has no __builtin_preserve_type_info equivalent, so the translation implements the C source's own #else fallback branch (data.skip = true) while the C object compiles the #if branch with real TYPE_EXISTS/MATCHES/SIZE relocations; the runtime harness honors data.skip

deliberate translation divergence (documented in test_xdp_devmap_tailcall.rs): C establishes PROG_ARRAY ownership by pre-populating .values (flexible-array ELF reloc Rust cannot emit); Rust adds a never-taken out-of-range bpf_tail_call(.., 1) for the same used_maps effect — extra tail_call trace event and success-fork by design
